# asc_role (Resource)

Manages a role in the authorization service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a role with specific permissions
resource "asc_role" "example" {
  name = "vm-operator"
  actions = [
    "vm:CreateVM",
    "vm:DeleteVM",
    "vm:ListVMs",
  ]
}

# Output the role details
output "role_name" {
  description = "The name of the created role"
  value       = asc_role.example.name
}

output "role_actions" {
  description = "The permission actions assigned to the role"
  value       = asc_role.example.actions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (List of String) The list of permission actions assigned to this role (e.g. "vm:CreateVM", "uam:ListUsers").
- `name` (String) The name of the role. Must be unique within the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the role (equals the role name).
